name: acme-certificates-manager
description: ACME Certificate Manager with automatic renewal and deployment

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.version:sync: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); require('fs').writeFileSync('frontend/src/app/version.ts', `// This file is auto-generated from package.json\nexport const VERSION = '${pkg.version}';\n`)"
